input_domain: a BIN object or an EXT object of every type from -128 to 127, with zero, one or two bytes of every value, printed into every buffer size from 0 to 24
limitations: msgpack_object_print_buffer for BIN and EXT objects of at most two bytes, with msgpack_object_bin_print_buffer and MSGPACK_CHECKED_CALL; the other object types, and with them arrays and maps, are not examined; the model reads snprintf and isprint as the stand-ins in the prelude: snprintf with ordinary characters and one %i, %d or %02x directive, isprint as in the C locale; the replay of a counterexample calls the C library; the type definitions are not extracted by the gate but copied into the prelude from include/msgpack/object.h at the same revision; an unwinding bound of 10
